description: Proxy d3d9.dll skeleton: backend loading (DXVK or system), config, UTC log, crash capture, exe-identity guard with pass-through, runtime patch engine fed by engine_sites, sha-checked install and byte-exact uninstall. No features.
title: Proxy DLL skeleton

description: Watcher and PC sync, ported from Empire's watcher v5 into the core: job requests with ids, enforced game lock, hang watchdog, config profiles restored byte for byte, headless virtual display (probe 1080p and 1440p modes), sha-checked PC sync. Unattended launch and kill of Napoleon.
title: Watcher and PC sync

description: Dev control channel and load time: measure each load phase first, then skip intros, autostart into a named scenario with the right map, warm the DXVK state cache, and reset in place instead of relaunching. Targets set from the measurements.
title: Dev control and load time

description: Scenario library and control API: scenarios registry filled (land, siege, naval, historical, campaign saves), fixed sky and weather, camera poses by id, scene/cam/shot/order/pause/speed/reset commands with built-in settle and checked results, frame-time and memory capture, then the acceptance run passing 20 times in a row (phase 1 gate).
title: Scenario library, control API, acceptance gate
